scenario.name: routine_checkup
scenario.goal: Schedule a routine annual physical checkup
scenario.context: Regular patient, been coming here for 3 years, healthy overall
scenario.personality: Friendly, organized, knows what she wants
scenario.notes: Ask for a morning slot if possible. Confirm date, time, and doctor name.
